subject: Post-call: VPC / Private deployment options for Acme Payments
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: VPC / Private deployment options for Acme Payments

Hi Sam

Thanks again for the time today

Really helpful to understand Acme Payments' latency and data-isolation needs for the payments product. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Summary: Your primary drivers are predictable per-token cost at scale, strict data isolation for payment PII, and an audit trail for vendors. You're evaluating whether Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools) meets throughput needs or if a Private VPC / on-prem option is required for compliance.

- What we proposed on the call: Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput + a Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) if strict network isolation / KMS controls are needed. I attached a short overview of our VPC/private options and a proposed mutual action plan.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll follow up with a ballpark pricing + timeline for both Dedicated and Private options (will include SOC 2 and audit artifacts).
2) Schedule a 30-min technical sync with Jonas (solutions) to map exact security & networking requirements.
3) If it looks like Private is needed, we'll scope a pilot plan and procurement checklist.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.pdf, redwood-vpc-overview.pdf

Can you confirm the right owner on your side for security/network (or should I include procurement and security@acmepayments.com)? Also let me know a few times next week that work for a short call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Hi Sam

Thanks

added Jonas and Laura here. Quick ballpark numbers to move the conversation forward (will provide a formal estimate after we confirm capacity and retention requirements):

- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity): ~$20k-$45k/month depending on committed throughput and latency SLOs. Typical onboarding 2-4 weeks for a standard pilot (provisioning, model pins, load tests).
- Private (VPC / on-prem): One-time platform setup fee + monthly platform maintenance. Ballpark licensing + integration starts around $75k-$150k for the initial deployment depending on on-prem sizing, with typical lead time of 6-10 weeks for on-prem (longer if air-gapped).

Compliance & docs: We are SOC 2 Type II, and I'll share the SOC summary and our encryption/KMS architecture after this message (link below).

Next steps I propose:
- 30-min technical sync with Jonas to review network requirements, KMS options, and pilot scope. (Schedule: https://cal.com/redwood/jonas-30m)
- I'll open a HubSpot deal with the mutual action plan so procurement can track items. (HubSpot link below).

Links: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/ACME-2026-D-42 | SOC2 summary: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/soc2-report-summary

Attached: redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf

If you can send two times that work for procurement+security, Jonas will take the technical lead on the call.

Best,
